Not all lakes are always turquoise: colour section describes changing blue/green/turquoise, while question says famous for. Plitvice is unique key2; Iguazu both sides is Argentina/Brazil (303 L43;355 L51), Vatnajökull Iceland (1604 L4/L38). Existing labels are not country-echoes of the question: reader must recognize Croatian park among real protected water landscapes.
